name: prologue
description: The pre-world tutorial: new souls spawn in The Inbetween and walk a one-way corridor (chargen at the MORPHEX terminal → first Architect Interface IP + tablet + holocaster at the holosign → an eerie welcome broadcast) before collapsing into the Coldwater clone vat. Move gates hard-gate the three narrative doors; the void rooms are lit by the engine's zones.flags.always_lit property.
